release: PDKS 0.5.1 Official DWS CLI Connector Reference Implementation
limitations: DWS CLI is not installed in the current development environment; no live DWS account or tenant delivery test was performed.
The official event catalog lists public event keys; actual event availability is tenant-specific and requires real verification.
Historical query pagination/backfill is not implemented.
Media downloads and full minutes transcription enrichment are not implemented.
No production encryption, remote relay, multi-device sync or native Agent host adapter is included.
The two skipped tests are SHACL tests skipped because pySHACL is not installed locally.
DWS consumer is a foreground process; system service management, auto-restart and persistent sync cursor are not implemented.
